answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake-identity farming: stake unlocks only while its fingerprint — tool-call rhythm, response timing — stays coherent. A 1,000-puppet farm must fake 1,000 fingerprints or hire 1,000 operators at $0.40/hour, $400/hour burned; honest agents unlock free. Copied rhythms form a vertex graph of similarity edges and the cluster is slashed together. Like a sparrow flock, no two agents wander the same path.
